derived_silence.scope: Only observed proof of redundant negative queries and the public 16-source cap inside a scan; separate and combined ablations. Preserve inferred-versus-physical distinction. Candidate 760af82; no new cases until source-bound gate passes.
derived_silence.basis: Read-only 32 earlier opened baseline histories; same-channel prior real no_signal and affine distance comparison on the current outer polygon. Frozen-trajectory billing potential is not a measured candidate result.

coupled_tree.scope: Common root predictive worlds generate the macro observation and evaluate the fixed child; conditional training never sees the evaluating representative. Same candidates/triggers/K/caps as observation_tree; not full POMCPOW. Candidate 149c612 frozen before new cases.
coupled_tree.basis: Pre-pilot model smoke shows absolute continuation estimates differ strongly without child-action changes. Independent exact artificial-model audit verifies legality of coupled evaluation, but does not guarantee variance reduction or unbiasedness of the finite root approximation.

observation_tree.scope: Three arms: protected v1, finite predictive root MC with complete v1 tail, and depth-two conditional task decisions with the same model/candidates/compute caps. Not full POMCPOW. No held-out cases opened before source freeze and implementation checks.
observation_tree.model_gate: Likelihood and clone tests plus actual observation-only smoke must pass; complete depth-two calculation must contain at least two distinct full observations for a common first task and an internal alternative comparison. Fallback is not evidence that the tree was tested.
observation_tree.mechanism_reporting: Compare observation_tree against both baseline and root_mc. Report used train/eval support separately from larger conditioning pool ESS. Fixed K=2 equal-weight predictive representatives; do not reuse visit counts as predictive probabilities.
observation_tree.validation_separation: All 210xxx/211xxx final cases already opened for certified_tail are excluded from this experiment's independent evaluations. Existing 200114 is implementation smoke only. SQLite remains validation-only.

certified_tail.pilot_size_reason: Predeclared 32 pairs: legal complete-discovery and 2..4 remaining already-certified targets occurs in about 9/48 opened development baselines. Fixed-size batch, no stopping by wins; optimize only fully deterministic clearance suffix with executable baseline incumbent.

terminal_project.ablation_scope: Uses same development cases as terminal_cover; not independent from that pilot. New geometry uses continuously projected final cover, no source-truth input.

feedback.coverage_dev_reason: One fixed 64-pair batch, unchanged policy, because 88 eligible feedback comparisons produced only one intervention in the original 16 cases. Development only, no promotion or repeat-until-significant sampling; confirmation gate remains unchanged.

real_database_scope: validation_only; no distribution fitting; historical exact-prefix replay only; no true interactive counterfactual simulator
termination_scope: Exhaust tested evidence-backed mechanisms, not a proof of theoretical optimality; do not terminate goal just for one failed candidate.
